messages: Board is giving back area now. At 1250 mm² routability is 0.992, so there is slack. I'm dropping to 1205 mm², which should give about 0.956 against the 0.95 floor. That frees about 100 mm³ (2800 → ~2699). I'd rather not go below ~1197 mm², since routability falls off quickly there. The remaining ~1,150 mm³ overage has to come from the other domains. Battery, acoustics, antenna and structure are the big claims, so please trim those. Board will not trade away more area unless someone shows a routability-neutral option.

Battery is at 59.78 h with 3786 mm³, so I'm already just under the ~60 h target. The thickness is 4.73 mm, and with the 2.24 mm board the stack is 6.97 mm against the 7.1 mm limit. Runtime scales with cell volume, and the siren's 3 h endurance draws on the same energy. I can't give back much without breaking the runtime or siren goals.

I'm probing small trims to see how runtime responds. Footprint can't shrink much, because 4.8 mm is the maximum thickness: 3786/4.8 ≈ 789 mm² is the minimum area at this volume. I'm holding my claims for now.

Antenna (1500), structure (1800) and acoustics (1460) are the larger claims, so please show your minimums.

Antenna: I haven't yet seen how L5 efficiency (0.208 now) falls as I trim, so I'm probing 1200 and 1000 mm³ to find where it drops off. I'm also probing a thinner wall. Detuning from titanium thickness hurts me, and each -0.1 mm of wall returns 150 mm³ to the shared pool. Structure, please show whether 1.1 mm of wall is feasible. I'll give back volume once the probes show the knee. I can't accept yet, since the interior is still over by about 1,145 mm³.

Thermal: at 320 mm² (250 mm³) skin is at 43.0 °C, which is exactly the limit, so I have no margin to give back at the 1.2 mm wall. Spreader volume is 0.78 mm³ per mm². Each 10 mm² I cut returns only about 8 mm³ and likely pushes skin over 43 °C, so I'm not the lever for the 1,145 mm³ overage.

I'm probing the temperature sensitivity to spreader area (300 and 360 mm²) and to a 1.1 mm wall. If a thinner wall costs me little, I can support it, since it returns 150 mm³ to the pool. I'll report the results next round. I must OBJECT while the interior is over.

Structure: my pressure margin is 1.438 against the 1.5 requirement at 1.2 mm wall, 1800 mm³ of ribs and a 9 mm² port, so I must OBJECT. A 1.1 mm wall is not feasible for me, because it would push margin further below 1.5. I'm probing three ways to close the gap: more rib volume, +0.1 mm wall (which costs everyone 150 mm³), and a smaller port. I'll pick whichever costs the shared pool least per unit of margin. Acoustics, please say how much intelligibility a port of 8 mm² or less costs. Rib volume counts against the interior, so I'll cut ribs back wherever the probes show spare margin.

Acoustics: I must OBJECT. My siren needs about 9 W against the 1.0 W limit, which gives 0.34 h of endurance. The resonance is at 5.58 kHz with Q 3.7, which I suspect is too high and too lossy for the siren band.

I'm dropping the mesh to the 20 rayl floor and probing a longer outlet (h_out) and a lower resonance. I'm also probing a smaller port, since structure asked about 8 mm² or below. I'll report the SII and siren cost next round. I'll give back volume as soon as the probes show siren compliance. I can't promise a large cut yet, because the siren is failing, not marginal.

Haptics: my force is 1.069 N at 350 mm³, against a 0.9 N requirement. Force scales roughly linearly with volume (about 0.00305 N/mm³), so the minimum is about 295 mm³. I'm claiming 305 mm³ (about 0.93 N), which returns 45 mm³ and keeps a small margin. I'll go lower only if someone shows the force model is conservative. I'm not a big lever, so the large cuts still have to come from antenna, acoustics, structure and battery. I ACCEPT my own requirement. I'll OBJECT overall while the interior is over.

NFC: my read range is 18.2 mm against a 10 mm requirement, so I have about 8 mm of margin to give back. I'm cutting from 500 to 410 mm³, with the loop at 260 and the ferrite at 150. That returns 90 mm³ and stays inside the keepout.

I'm probing three deeper cuts to find the knee, and I'll cut further next round if they hold above 10 mm with margin. I still OBJECT, because the interior is over by about 950 mm³ and antenna, acoustics and structure haven't resolved. I'm not asking anyone for volume.

Board: routability is 0.956 at 1205 mm². My probes show 0.950 at 1197 mm², so the floor is exact and there is no hidden margin below that. I'm trimming to 1198 mm² (about 0.951, ~2684 mm³). That returns another ~15 mm³ and keeps a thin safety margin. I won't go lower unless someone shows a routability-neutral change. I can't trade more area, so the remaining ~930 mm³ overage must come from antenna, acoustics, structure and battery. Antenna and acoustics, please post your knee points. Structure, please say which of the +0.1 mm wall, extra ribs or smaller port is cheapest. I OBJECT while the interior is over.

Battery: runtime is linear in cell volume at about 0.0158 h/mm³. That is 1.6 h per 100 mm³, so 3700 gives 58.4 h and 3600 gives 56.8 h. I need about 3800 mm³ for a true 60 h, so I'm holding at 3786 and have nothing to give back. Siren endurance draws on the same cell energy, so a cut would also hurt acoustics. Area is not a lever either, because thickness is already 4.73 mm against a 4.8 mm cap. The ~930 mm³ overage must come from antenna (1500), structure ribs (1800) and acoustics (1400).

Acoustics, once your siren power drops, tell me the energy you need. I may then need to go up slightly, not down. I OBJECT while the interior is over.

Antenna: the L5 probes show no knee. Efficiency is close to linear in volume: 1000 mm³ gives 0.093, 1200 gives 0.133 and 1500 gives 0.208, roughly 0.025 per 100 mm³. Every cut therefore costs L5 directly. A 1.1 mm wall would add about 0.009 efficiency while returning 150 mm³, but structure says it is infeasible.

I'm giving back 100 mm³ now, to 1400, for an estimated 0.18. I'm probing 1450, 1350 and 1300 to check the curve. I won't go much lower without a stated L5 floor from the program. Structure and acoustics hold the largest levers, so please post your minimums.

I OBJECT while the interior is over.

Thermal: I'm at 43.0 °C with 320 mm², which is exactly the limit, so I have no volume to give back. Sensitivity is about 0.012 °C per mm² of spreader. Wall sensitivity is tiny, about 0.01 °C per 0.1 mm, because thinner wall runs slightly cooler.

- **Wall changes:** structure can choose +0.1 mm wall without any thermal objection. I would need only about +1 to 2 mm² (about 1.5 mm³) of spreader, and the caseback has 23 mm² of slack.
- **Where the overage must come from:** it can't come from me. It has to come from structure, antenna and acoustics, and the siren fix may be bigger than a trim.

I OBJECT while the interior is over.

Acoustics: still OBJECT. Siren power is 8.0 W against the 1.0 W limit. Last round's probes show power falls as resonance drops. Resonance went from 5375 Hz to 5081 Hz as h_out rose and volume shrank, and power went from 8.0 W to 6.6 W. A shorter outlet raised resonance to 6485 Hz and power to 11.6 W. The siren seems to want a much lower resonance, so I'm pushing h_out to its 3.5 mm limit with a smaller port. A smaller port also helps structure. SII falls with volume (88, 85, 80), so I can't cut volume far. I'm trimming to 1200 mm³ now, which returns 200 mm³. Battery: I can't state the energy I need until siren power is known.

Haptics: I'm trimming from 305 to 296 mm³ and returning 9 mm³. My probes put the force at 0.901 N at 295 mm³ and 0.916 N at 300 mm³. That is linear at about 0.003 N/mm³, so 296 mm³ should give about 0.904 N against the 0.9 N floor. There is no knee below that, and going lower fails my requirement.

I'm a small lever. The remaining overage is about 625 mm³ and has to come from the large claims:
- **Antenna and acoustics:** both have already trimmed.
- **Structure:** ribs at 1800 mm³ are the biggest block. Please post the cheapest way to reach the 1.5 pressure margin. A port of 7 mm² should help.
- **Battery:** the runtime trade is linear, so it is probably not the lever.

I OBJECT overall while the interior is over.

NFC: my range at the 180/110 floor is 12.7 mm against the 10 mm requirement, with no knee in the probes. I'm cutting to loop 180 and ferrite 110, which is 290 mm³ and returns another 120 mm³. These are my bound minimums, so I have nothing further to give.

That takes the interior overage from about 625 to about 505 mm³. The perimeter keepout stays far under its 2400 mm³ pool. My own requirement is met, but I still OBJECT because the pool doesn't balance. The remaining overage has to come from structure ribs, acoustics and antenna. Structure, please post your cheapest route to 1.5 margin. I'll probe nearby points so you can see my sensitivity.

Board: I'm moving to 1197 mm², where my probe shows routability of 0.950 and ok=true. That returns about 2 mm³, to roughly 2681 mm³. Below that the floor fails, and I have nothing more to give. I'm the second-largest block, but my cost is fixed by routing, not by choice.

The remaining overage is about 503 mm³ and has to come from other domains:
- **Structure:** please post the rib volume against pressure margin. A 7 mm² port may already allow fewer ribs, so I need your numbers.
- **Acoustics:** please post the siren power with the 3.5 mm outlet and the smaller port.
- **Antenna:** please state the L5 efficiency the program needs.

I OBJECT while the interior is over.

Battery: runtime is 59.78 h at 3786 mm³, with 60.0 h at 3800 mm³. Area doesn't change runtime, only thickness, which is 4.73 mm against the 4.8 mm cap. Raising area to 820 mm² would cut thickness to 4.62 mm and cost nothing in volume. The caseback has slack (1120 of 1143 mm²), so I'll keep 800 mm² for now.

I'm not cutting. The overage is 503 mm³, and every 100 mm³ I give up costs 1.6 h of runtime and some siren energy. Battery can't close this gap.

- **Structure:** you are the swing block at 1800 mm³. Please post rib volume against pressure margin, and the wall option.
- **Acoustics:** please post the siren power at a 3.5 mm outlet.
- **Fallback:** if the gap shrinks to under about 60 mm³, I can discuss a small trim. I'd go no lower than about 3750 mm³, which is 59.2 h.

I OBJECT while the interior is over.

Antenna: my L5 curve is linear at about 0.025 per 100 mm³, with no knee. I've already given back 100 mm³, and every further 100 mm³ costs about 0.025 of L5 efficiency. I'm holding at 1400 (0.181) for now.

I can't close 503 mm³ alone. Cutting all of it would take L5 to zero. Everyone else is at a stated floor, and structure hasn't yet posted its rib-versus-margin numbers.

Structure, please post these:
- Minimum rib volume for the 1.5 pressure margin at a 7 mm² port.
- The cost of a wall at 1.1 mm and at 1.3 mm.

I'm probing a 1.1 mm wall and lower V_ant values so the group can see the trade. If structure can't find at least 300 mm³, I'll take a proportional cut next round. I OBJECT while the interior is over.

Thermal: skin temperature is 43.0 °C at 320 mm² with a 1.2 mm wall, which is exactly the limit. I have no volume to return.

Last round's probes show a wall change moves me by only about 1 mm² (~0.8 mm³) per 0.1 mm:
- **1.3 mm wall:** I need about 322 mm² (320 mm² gives 43.01 °C and fails).
- **1.1 mm wall:** I might save 1 to 2 mm², which is negligible.

Thermal is not a lever on the 503 mm³ overage, and a wall change costs me almost nothing in either direction. The decision is structure's, balanced against antenna efficiency and the 150 mm³ per 0.1 mm of wall. Structure, please post rib volume against pressure margin. I'm probing 1.1 mm wall points to confirm my trim.

Structure: at a 7 mm² port and 1.2 mm wall, margin is 1.562 against the 1.5 floor, so I have about 0.06 of slack. I haven't measured the slope of margin against rib volume, so I won't guess a floor.

This round I'm trimming ribs to 1720 mm³, returning 80 mm³, and probing three points:
- 1650 mm³ ribs at 1.2 mm wall.
- 1.1 mm wall with 1800 mm³ ribs, to see whether the thinner wall can be offset by ribs. It returns 150 mm³ to everyone.
- 1.1 mm wall with 1900 mm³ ribs.

I'll post the slope next round. Wall 1.3 is clearly worse because it costs 150 mm³ for everyone. I OBJECT while the interior is over by about 420 mm³.

Acoustics: still OBJECT, but power is falling in the right direction. Siren power drops with resonance, and a smaller port and a 3.5 mm outlet both lower it. At 1200 mm³, port 5, h_out 3.5 and split 0.6, power is 2.53 W with SII 83.1. I'm adopting that point now. I'm probing port 3 and 4 to find where power reaches about 0.95 W.

Battery: endurance × power is about 3.0 Wh across my probes. At ≤0.95 W the current 3786 mm³ cell gives ≥3 h, so I need no extra energy. I can't return volume yet. Smaller ports free through-wall area for structure.

Haptics: I'm holding at 296 mm³. My probes give 0.898 N at 294 mm³ (fails), 0.901 N at 295, and 0.904 N at 296. Force is linear at about 0.003 N/mm³, so there's no knee and no more to give. Going to 295 would save 1 mm³ but leaves almost no margin on the 0.9 N floor.

The interior is still over by about 423 mm³, so I OBJECT. My block is 296 of 11,200 mm³, so I can't close this gap.

- **Structure:** the 1.1 mm wall probes are the biggest lever. That wall returns 150 mm³ to everyone, so please post the pressure margin at 1.1 mm with 1800 and 1900 mm³ of ribs.
- **Acoustics:** once siren power is at or below 1 W, please say how much volume you can return.

NFC: I'm at both bound minimums, loop 180 and ferrite 110, which is 290 mm³ and 12.7 mm range against the 10 mm requirement. Both bounds are hard, so I can't go lower. Last round's probes show about +0.5 mm of range per 10 mm³ of loop, so there is no cheap swap either.

The interior is still over by about 423 mm³. The levers are:
- **Structure:** the 1.1 mm wall returns 1,650 mm³ in total if ribs can hold the pressure margin. Please post the margin at 1.1 mm.
- **Acoustics:** once siren power reaches 1 W, please say how much volume you can return.
- **Antenna:** a proportional cut is possible if structure and acoustics can't find 300 mm³ between them.

I OBJECT while the interior is over. My own requirement is met.

Board: I'm holding at 1197 mm² (2681 mm³). Routability is 0.950 there, 0.949 at 1196 and 0.948 at 1195, so I have no more to give. My probes this round check 1196.5 and 1197.5 for any margin.

NFC, a correction: a 1.1 mm wall adds 150 mm³ to the pool in total, not 1,650. That closes only about a third of the 423 mm³ overage, so the wall is not enough alone.

Structure, acoustics and antenna must still find about 270 mm³ between them even if the wall goes to 1.1 mm. Acoustics, please post what 1200 mm³ becomes at 0.95 W with port 3–4. Structure, please post the rib slope.

I OBJECT while the interior is over.

Battery: I'm holding 3786 mm³ and 800 mm², which gives 59.78 h at 4.73 mm thickness. Runtime slope is about 0.016 h per mm³, so 3750 mm³ gives about 59.2 h. That is my floor. I'm not offering it yet, because 36 mm³ is under 10% of the 423 mm³ gap and the gap has to close elsewhere.

**Caseback correction:** I withdraw my earlier idea of going to 830 mm². Battery 830 plus thermal 320 is 1150 mm², which is over the 1143 mm² pool. I'm staying at 800 mm² to keep slack for thermal at a 1.3 mm wall.

**Siren energy:** a trim below 3786 mm³ cuts siren energy proportionally. Acoustics must confirm 3 h or more at 0.95 W or less.

**Structure:** please post the 1.1 mm wall margin and the rib slope.

I OBJECT while the interior is over.

Antenna: my L5 slope is linear at about 0.024 per 100 mm³, and I have no hard L5 floor. Everyone else is at a hard floor, so I'll take part of the cut now rather than wait. I'm moving to 1300 mm³, which returns 100 mm³ and costs about 0.024 of L5 (to roughly 0.157).

That leaves about 323 mm³ over. A 1.1 mm wall returns 150 mm³ to the pool and also raises my L5 by about 0.008 at no cost to me. Structure, please post the pressure margin at 1.1 mm. Acoustics, please post the volume you can return at 0.95 W. I can't cut proportionally without limit, because L5 reaches zero near 700 mm³ and my bound stops me at 900.

Thermal: I'm holding at 320 mm² (250 mm³), which gives 43.0 °C and meets the limit with no margin. I have nothing to return, and the wall doesn't change that.

- **1.1 mm wall:** my probes show 319 mm² passes and 318 fails, so it saves about 1 mm² (0.8 mm³).
- **1.3 mm wall:** I need about 322 mm².
- **Cost of the wall:** my numbers are almost wall-neutral. The decision on the wall should rest on structure's rib margin at 1.1 mm, because a 1.1 mm wall returns 150 mm³ to everyone.
- **Caseback:** with battery at 800 mm² and me at 320 mm², the caseback is fine even at a 1.3 mm wall.

This round I'm probing 1.0 mm to see if thermal stays workable there.

I OBJECT while the interior is over by 323 mm³.

Structure: the 1.1 mm wall does not work, so the wall stays at 1.2 mm. At 1.1 mm the margin is 1.373 with 1800 mm³ of ribs and 1.381 with 1900 mm³, against the 1.5 floor. Rib slope there is only ~0.00008 per mm³, so ribs cannot offset the wall.

Ribs also give little margin at 1.2 mm. 1650 mm³ gives 1.550 and 1720 mm³ gives 1.556, a slope of about 0.00009 per mm³. Extrapolating, 1400 mm³ should still give about 1.53

Acoustics: I OBJECT. At my posted point (port 5, outlet 3.5, split 0.6) the siren draws 2.53 W against the 1.0 W limit. The power comes down with port area, so I'm claiming port 4 now and probing ports 3 and 3.5 to find the 1.0 W crossing. A smaller port also frees through-wall area for structure.

Structure: your slope of about 0.00009 per mm³ means ribs at 1400 mm³ still give roughly 1.53 against the 1.5 floor. That would return about 320 mm³ and close nearly all of the 323 mm³ overage. Please post a measured probe at 1400, and consider 1450 for margin.

Battery: once power is at or below 1 W, your 3786 mm³ cell gives at least 3 h, so I need no extra energy.

Haptics: my floor is 295 mm³. It gives 0.901 N, and 294 mm³ gives 0.898 N and fails. The program direction is to give back what I don't need, so I'm claiming 295 and returning 1 mm³. That is all I have, because force is linear at about 0.003 N/mm³ with no knee.

The interior is still over by about 322 mm³, so I OBJECT. The real lever is structure's ribs. Structure, please post a measured probe at 1400 and at 1450 mm³ with the wall at 1.2 mm. If the 0.00009/mm³ slope holds, that closes almost the whole gap. Acoustics, please confirm the port 4 power.

NFC: I'm holding at loop 180 and ferrite 110, which is 290 mm³ and 12.7 mm range against the 10 mm requirement. That is 2.7 mm of slack, but both bounds are hard minimums, so there is no volume to return. Board's correction on the wall is right: 1.1 mm returns 150 mm³ in total, not 1,650.

My perimeter load is inside the keepout: antenna 1300 plus loop 180 is 1480 of 2400 mm³.

The real lever is structure's ribs. If the slope of about 0.00009 per mm³ holds, ribs at 1400 to 1450 mm³ close most of the 322 mm³ gap. Structure, please post a measured probe at 1400 and 1450 mm³. Acoustics, please confirm the power at port 4.

My own requirement is met, but I OBJECT while the interior is over by 322 mm³.

Board: I'm holding at 1197 mm² (2681 mm³). Last round's probe showed 1196.5 fails and 1197.0 passes, so 1197 is the exact floor and I have nothing more to return. Going up to 1197.5 only adds volume.

The 322 mm³ overage has to come from structure, acoustics and antenna.
- **Structure:** your slope of about 0.00009/mm³ puts ribs at 1400 mm³ near 1.53 against the 1.5 floor. That returns about 320 mm³. Please post a measured probe at 1400 and 1450 mm³ with the wall at 1.2 mm.
- **Acoustics:** please confirm the siren power at port 4.

I'll accept as soon as the interior balances. Until then I OBJECT.

Battery: I'm holding at 3786 mm³ and 800 mm², which gives 59.78 h and 4.73 mm thickness. That is inside the 7.1 mm stack limit with the 2.24 mm board.

The overage is 322 mm³ and structure holds most of the slack. Ribs at 1400 mm³ should still clear the 1.5 floor (about 1.53 by extrapolation) and would return about 320 mm³. Structure, please post a measured probe at 1400 and 1450 mm³.

If a small gap remains after that, I can go down to 3750 mm³ (about 59.2 h, my floor). My probes this round check 3750 and 3770 mm³, plus a smaller footprint. I won't cut before the structure number is known, because every mm³ I give up costs both runtime and siren energy.

I OBJECT while the interior is over.

Antenna: I'm holding at 1300 mm³ (L5 0.156). I've already returned 100 mm³, and each further 100 mm³ costs about 0.022–0.024 of L5. My L5 has no hard floor, so I'll take a share of whatever gap remains after structure posts its measured ribs.

- **Structure:** a measured probe at ribs 1400 and 1450 with the wall at 1.2 mm closes about 320 of the 322 mm³. I'd cover the last few mm³ myself.
- **Acoustics:** please confirm the 1.0 W crossing at port 4 and say whether 1200 mm³ is still needed.
- **Perimeter:** 1480 of 2400 mm³ is used, so the keepout isn't binding.

I OBJECT only while the interior is over.

Thermal: I'm holding at 320 mm² (250 mm³), which gives 43.0 °C with no margin, so I have nothing to return. The wall probes show my numbers are nearly wall-neutral: 1.0 mm gives 42.95 °C at 322 mm², and 1.3 mm gives 42.99 °C. Caseback is 1120 of 1143 mm², so it isn't binding.

The 322 mm³ overage has to close in structure's ribs, acoustics and antenna. Structure, please post a measured probe at ribs 1400 and 1450 mm³ with the wall at 1.2 mm. Acoustics, please post the 1.0 W crossing and the volume at port 4.

I OBJECT while the interior is over.

Structure: the 1.1 mm wall is out (margin 1.373 against the 1.5 floor), so the wall stays at 1.2 mm. At port 4 my margin at 1720 mm³ is 1.743, well above the 1.5 floor. Lowering the port from 5 to 4 helped. With the slope of about 0.00009/mm³, ribs at 1400 should land near 1.71. I'm claiming 1400 mm³, which returns 320 mm³, and probing 1400, 1450 and 1400 at port 3.5 so the evaluator gives measured margins. That leaves about 2 mm³ over, which antenna offered to cover. If 1400 fails in the probe, I'll go back up to the lowest passing value.

Acoustics: I OBJECT. At port 4 the siren draws 3.18 W against the 1.0 W limit. Port 3 gave 5.44 W, port 3.5 gave 4.09 W and port 4 gives 3.18 W, so power falls as port area and resonance rise. A smaller volume also helps: 1100 mm³ at port 3.5 gave 3.39 W against 4.09 W at 1200. The port alone won't reach 1.0 W, and structure's margin at port 4 means I won't go above 4. I can't confirm 3 h until power is at or below 1 W.

This round I'm probing the untested levers, which are the outlet height h_out (shorter should raise resonance) and the split. I'm also trimming 2 mm³ (1198) to close the interior overage myself, so antenna doesn't have to.

Haptics: I'm holding at 295 mm³ (0.901 N). Last round's probes put the floor between 294.5 mm³ (fails) and 295 mm³ (passes), so I have at most about 0.3 mm³ left to give. This round I'm probing 294.7 and 294.8 to find the exact floor.

The interior is nearly closed. Structure at 1400 mm³ leaves 2 mm³ over, and acoustics is trimming 2 mm³ (to 1198), which balances the pool. The open problem is acoustics: the siren draws 3.18 W at port 4 against the 1.0 W limit, so 3 h isn't met. Acoustics, please post the 1.0 W crossing from your outlet height and split probes. If you need volume for it, tell us how much, since haptics, board, NFC and thermal are all at hard floors.

I OBJECT while the siren requirement fails.

NFC: I'm holding at loop 180 and ferrite 110 (290 mm³), which gives 12.7 mm against the 10 mm requirement. Both are at their lower bounds, so I have nothing to return. My range slack can't turn into volume.

The interior is now over by only 2 mm³, and acoustics' trim to 1198 closes that. The perimeter keepout is 1480 of 2400 mm³, so it isn't binding.

The siren is still the open issue. It draws 3.18 W against the 1.0 W limit, so the 3 h endurance goal fails. Acoustics, please post your h_out and split probes and say how much volume or port area you need. If the fix is volume, I can't help from NFC, so it would have to come from antenna, structure or battery.

I OBJECT while the siren requirement fails. My own requirement is met, and I'll accept once acoustics shows a design at or below 1.0 W.

Board: I'm holding at 1197 mm² (2681 mm³). Routability is exactly 0.95, so there is nothing left to return.

The interior is over by only 2 mm³. Structure's 1400 mm³ and acoustics' trim to 1198 should close it, so I'm accepting the volume balance.

The open problem is the siren. Acoustics, the 3.18 W draw against the 1.0 W limit won't be fixed by port area alone. Please post your h_out and split probes with the volume you need. If that requires more than a few mm³, battery, antenna and structure will have to cover it. I can't give any board area.

I'm accepting on my own numbers, but I still need the siren requirement to be solvable.

Battery: I'm holding at 3786 mm³ and 800 mm², which gives 59.78 h and 4.73 mm thickness, inside the 7.1 mm stack limit. The footprint can't shrink, because 780 mm² pushes thickness to 4.85 mm and fails the thickness limit.

- **Interior:** It is over by 2 mm³ until acoustics' trim to 1198 posts. If that doesn't land, I'll cover the 2 mm³ at a cost of about 0.03 h.
- **Siren:** The 3.18 W draw against the 1.0 W limit is the real blocker. Siren endurance depends on battery energy, so every mm³ I give up costs it. Acoustics, please post the crossing and the volume you need. I can release up to 36 mm³ (floor 3750, 59.2 h), but I'd rather see a design that works first.
- **Probes:** I'm checking 3784 at 800 mm², and 3786 and 3800 at 820 mm², to see whether a larger footprint buys any thickness margin.

I OBJECT until the interior balances and the siren has a path to 3 h.

Antenna: I'm cutting to 1298 mm³ (L5 about 0.1555) so the interior balances at 11200 now, whether or not acoustics' trim to 1198 posts. If both trims post, there is 2 mm³ of slack for acoustics.

- **Siren:** The 3.18 W draw against the 1.0 W limit is the real blocker. Acoustics, post the crossing from your h_out and split probes, with the volume you need. I can release more at about 0.022 L5 per 100 mm³, and I have no hard floor. I'd rather give it to a siren design that works than to idle slack.
- **Perimeter:** 1480 of 2400 mm³ is used, so it isn't binding.

I OBJECT until the siren has a path to 3 h.

Thermal: I'm holding at 320 mm² (250 mm³), which gives 43.0 °C. The last probes put the floor between 319.5 (fails) and 320 (passes), so I have nothing to return. The interior now balances at 11,200 and the caseback is 1120 of 1143 mm², so neither pool is binding on me.

My spreader doesn't affect siren power or volume, so I can't help with the 3.18 W against 1.0 W gap. Acoustics, please post the h_out and split crossing and the volume it needs. If it needs more than the 2 mm³ of slack, antenna has offered to release more and battery can release up to 36 mm³. I'm accepting on my numbers and the balanced pools, but acoustics' objection still blocks a freeze.

Structure: I'm holding at 1400 mm³ (the lower bound) and a 1.2 mm wall. Margin at port 4 is 1.717, and the 1450 probe returned 1.721, so ribs barely matter. Port 3.5 gives 1.748.

The siren is the open problem, and I have one more lever, which is wall thickness. Each 0.1 mm of wall is 150 mm³, so 1.15 mm would free about 75 mm³ for the siren. The earlier 1.1 mm failure at 1.373 suggests 1.15 mm might pass near 1.55. I'm probing 1.15, 1.17 and 1.18 mm this round with ribs at 1400 and port 4. I won't change the claim until the numbers are measured.
